name: Banshee
strength: Only targets one person at a time.
weakness: Fears the Crucifix and is less aggressive near one.

name: Demon
strength: Attacks more often than any other ghost.
weakness: Asking a Demon successful Ouija board questions won't lower your sanity.

name: Goryo
strength: A Goryo will usually only show itself on camera if there are no people nearby.
weakness: Is rarely seen far from its place of death.

name: Hantu
strength: Lower temperatures can cause the Hantu to move at faster speeds.
weakness: A Hantu will move slower in warm areas.

name: Jinn
strength: Travels at a faster speed if a victim is far away.
weakness: Turning off a power source will prevent the Jinn from using its ability.

name: Mare
strength: Increased chance to attack in the dark.
weakness: Turning the lights on lowers its chance to attack.

name: Myling
strength: Known to be quieter when hunting.
weakness: Makes paranormal sounds more frequently.

name: Oni
strength: Can move objects and is more active with people nearby.
weakness: Is easy to find and identify because it is very active.

name: Phantom
strength: Sanity drops considerably when looking at a Phantom.
weakness: Taking a photo of a Phantom will make it temporarily disappear.

name: Poltergeist
strength: Throws a huge amount of objects at once.
weakness: Ineffective in an empty room.

name: Revenant
strength: Travels significantly faster when hunting a victim.
weakness: Hiding from a Revenant causes it to move very slowly.

name: Shade
strength: Shy, making it difficult to locate.
weakness: Will not enter hunting mode with multiple people nearby.

name: Spirit
strength: Has no special strengths.
weakness: Smudge Sticks will stop it from attacking for a long period of time.

name: Wraith
strength: Can't be tracked by footsteps.
weakness: Has a toxic reaction to salt.

name: Yokai
strength: Talking near a Yokai will anger it and increase its chance of attacking.
weakness: When hunting, a Yokai can only hear voices close to it.

name: Yurei
strength: Has a stronger effect on your sanity.
weakness: Using Smudge Sticks in a Yurei's room will prevent it from wandering for a long time.

name: Deogen
strength: Always knows where you are hiding
weakness: Moves at a snail's pace once it gets close to you.

name: Goryo
strength: A Goryo will usually only show itself on camera if there are no people nearby.
weakness: They are rarely seen far from their place of death.

name: Moroi
strength: Curses players (draining sanity faster via Spirit Box or parabolic mic) and moves faster as team sanity drops.
weakness: Smudge sticks blind and disorient it for 50% longer.

name: Obake
strength: When interacting with the environment, an Obake will rarely leave a trace.
weakness: Sometimes this ghost will shapeshift, leaving behind unique evidence.

name: Obambo
strength: Extinguishing a flame can cause an Onryo to attack.
weakness: When threatened, this ghost will be less likely to hunt.

name: Onryo
strength: Extinguishing a flame can cause an Onryo to attack.
weakness: When threatened, this ghost will be less likely to hunt.

name: Raiju
strength: A Raiju can siphon power from nearby electrical devices, making it move faster.
weakness: Raiju are constantly disrupting electronic equipment when attacking, making it easier to track.

name: Thaye
strength: Starts the investigation fast, active, and dangerous.
weakness: Ages over time as you stay near it, becoming progressively slower and less active.

name: The Mimic
strength: Can copy the traits, speeds, and behaviors of any other ghost type.
weakness: Always spawns with fake 'Ghost Orbs' floating around it as a secondary signature.

name: The Twins
strength: One ghost starts the hunt.
weakness: May throw objects at different locations at the same time.
